Jharkhand News: jharkhand ki bari khabren | Asian Games | SIR in Jharkhand | CM Hemant | Weather News
Bari khabar rajdhani ranchi se hai... jahan, rahul sinh giroh ke 2 apradhiyon ke sath pulis ki muthbher huee... pulis ki javabi karravaee men shahid namak aaropi ko goli lagi... ghayal ko rims men ilaj ke bheja gaya... vahi, ek any aaropi ko bhi pulis ne giraphtar kiya hai... inke pas se do pistal aur kartus bhi baramad ki gaee hai...
